recorded.deviations_from_script_loops: None in the loops: L6, L8, L9, L11 are the four words of check_fixed_palette token by token (cross_check.py). Semantics: the script checks a word cyclically for disjoint adjacent palettes and full-cover triples; the Lean file checks the same via windows of the word closed with A0 B0 (LinGood (w ++ [A0,B0])), which equals the cyclic check when w starts with A0 B0 (this is how Loop is defined), and then proves the vertex-level Proper/Sees from it (colouring_of_loop). Concatenation is list append, as in the script's string concatenation. The Lean representation of n >= 14 uses n = 6a+8b+9c+11d via rep_of_ge14 (bases 14..19 exactly as Section 8: 14=6+8, 15=6+9, 16=8+8, 17=6+11, 18=9+9, 19=8+11, then +6); the script instead checks the semigroup numerically to 201.
recorded.graph: V n := Fin n x Fin 3 (bag, label); adj (i,a) (j,b) := (i = j and a != b) or j = i + 1 or i = j + 1 in Fin n (mod n); [NeZero n] is required for 1 : Fin n; same conventions as C11K3.lean with 11 -> n
recorded.kernel_evaluation_used_for: linGoodB (L ++ [A0,B0]) for the four loops (plain decide; no decide +kernel, no native_decide). Everything else is a structural proof (Finset counting, list index lemmas via List.getD/getElem?, Fin n arithmetic via Fin.val_add, omega).

predicates.NoSingleRecolour c: forall proper g agreeing with c off v, g v = c v (reconfiguration form)
predicates.Proper c: forall u v, adj u v = true -> c u != c v
predicates.Sees c: forall v col, col != c v -> exists u, adj v u = true and c u = col (frozen, closed-neighbourhood form)

recorded.task: lower_palette_lean_20260922/q3_law: kernel certificate of the exact lower-palette law for C_n[K_3] at 8 colours (necessity, sufficiency, iff), from LOWER_PALETTE_EXPLORATION.md Section 8 and the four loops of check_rotated_domination_family.py

theorems.Q3Law.Loop.append: UNIVERSAL. Loop u -> Loop v -> Loop (u ++ v) (loops based at (012,345) concatenate)
theorems.Q3Law.admissible_iff: UNIVERSAL (omega). 4 <= n -> (8*((n+2)/3) <= 3n <-> n = 6 or 8 or 9 or 11 or 12 or 14 <= n)
theorems.Q3Law.bags_dominating: UNIVERSAL. Sees c -> for every colour col and bag i, one of i-1, i, i+1 carries a vertex of colour col
theorems.Q3Law.ceil_le_of_dominating: UNIVERSAL. same hypothesis -> (n+2)/3 <= D.card, i.e. |D| >= ceil(n/3)
theorems.Q3Law.cls_card_ge: UNIVERSAL. Sees c -> every colour class has >= (n+2)/3 vertices
theorems.Q3Law.colouring_of_loop: UNIVERSAL. Loop w -> w.length = n -> 2 <= n -> Proper (colOf n w) and Sees (colOf n w) (a loop read cyclically is a proper frozen 8-colouring)
theorems.Q3Law.cycle_dominating_card: UNIVERSAL. D : Finset (Fin n), (forall i, i-1 in D or i in D or i+1 in D) -> n <= 3 * D.card  [univ subset of biUnion of {d-1,d,d+1}; each has card <= 3]
theorems.Q3Law.exact_law: UNIVERSAL. 4 <= n -> ((exists c, Proper c and Sees c) <-> 8 * ((n+2)/3) <= 3 * n)
theorems.Q3Law.exact_law_ceil: UNIVERSAL. 4 <= n -> ((exists c, Proper c and Sees c) <-> 8 * ceil((n:Q)/3) <= 3 * n)  [literal ceiling form]
theorems.Q3Law.exact_law_explicit: UNIVERSAL. 4 <= n -> ((exists c, Proper c and Sees c) <-> n = 6 or 8 or 9 or 11 or 12 or 14 <= n)
theorems.Q3Law.exists_noSingleRecolour: UNIVERSAL. admissible n -> exists c, Proper c and NoSingleRecolour c
theorems.Q3Law.linGood_append: UNIVERSAL sliding-window lemma on words: LinGood (u ++ v.take 2) -> LinGood v -> LinGood (u ++ v)
theorems.Q3Law.loop6 / loop8 / loop9 / loop11: FINITE (kernel decide on linGoodB (L ++ [A0,B0])): the four literal words are loops
theorems.Q3Law.necessity: UNIVERSAL. c : V n -> Fin 8, Proper c -> Sees c -> 8 * ((n+2)/3) <= 3 * n (the task's statement; Proper is an unused hypothesis)
theorems.Q3Law.necessity_of_sees: UNIVERSAL (all n >= 1). c : V n -> Fin 8, Sees c -> 8 * ((n+2)/3) <= 3 * n. Properness is NOT needed.
theorems.Q3Law.no_frozen_4/5/7/10/13: corollaries: forall c : V n -> Fin 8, not Sees c for n = 4, 5, 7, 10, 13
theorems.Q3Law.rep_of_ge14: UNIVERSAL (strong induction, step 6, base 14..19). 14 <= n -> exists a b c d, n = 6a+8b+9c+11d
theorems.Q3Law.sufficiency: UNIVERSAL. n in {6,8,9,11,12} or 14 <= n -> exists c : V n -> Fin 8, Proper c and Sees c
theorems.Q3Law.word_loop: UNIVERSAL. forall a b c d, Loop (L6^a ++ L8^b ++ L9^c ++ L11^d)
